description: An omission is forbidden only where the optional can be read whole. On B D T, c → B leaves out [T A] before D. The longer c → B D reaches the written T, but [T A] cannot complete there, so the omission is permitted, and begins of r holds. Reading the terminator alone is not enough (engine §4).
grammar:
%elidable T
%rule text B D T
%conditions begins(from($), r)
%rule r c [T A] D
%rule c B | B D
